remarks: Condo living at its best! Experience unparalleled comfort and convenience in this 2 bedroom, 2 bath, 3 level condo. This unique unit, completely rebuilt in 2015, boasts finished attic space for storage, its own exercise room with full bath, providing a perfect blend of luxury and functionality. Enjoy your private enclosed patio for relaxation and entertainment. Located in a prime spot, you'll be just a short walk away from the vibrant SoNo district, featuring an array of nightlife options, a movie theatre and the Maritime Aquarium. Additionally, the nearby railroad station offers easy access to New York City and Boston. Take in views of Long Island Sound from this one-of-a-kind unit. Don't miss this opportunity for enjoyable living. Please submit offers by Monday, 6/24 at 7PM. thanks
